summary: Tested Paavni expense/payment MVP (backend FastAPI + MongoDB, frontend Expo Router). Backend: 13/14 pytest tests pass; the 1 failure is a test-ordering race in parallel pytest execution (dashboard test ran before another worker created expenses) - NOT a backend bug. All endpoints (masters, vendors CRUD, categories CRUD, expenses CRUD + record payment + derived fields month/outstanding/payment_status, dashboard aggregations with sort+months list) work correctly. Soft-delete via deleted_at verified. Frontend: Dashboard renders brand header + month selector + empty state (current month Oct 2026 has no data, matches spec); Expenses list shows seed + test rows, all 4 status filter chips present and tappable, scope toggle works, rows tappable. Manage tab vendor add/list/delete works; segmented control switches to Categories. Expense form opens from Dashboard FAB/empty-state CTA, vendor picker searches + adds custom vendor, main category picker works, status chips (Unpaid/Partly Paid/Paid) work, Save returns to dashboard. React-native-web console shows two minor deprecation warnings (shadow* props, pointerEvents prop) from library-rendered styles - cosmetic.

minor.issue: Returns 200 instead of 201 for creation (FastAPI default). Not blocking; frontend tolerates it.
Full-replace semantics: ExpenseCreate payload wipes any field not sent (e.g., payment_mode, cost_centre). Frontend sends full body so it works, but a PATCH-style merge would be safer long-term.

issues: Default month = currentMonth() shows empty state immediately on first launch while seed data lives in May 2026. User has to tap month selector to discover existing data. Consider defaulting to the latest month that has data (data.months[0]) when currentMonth() is empty.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Appears from a library (likely a chart/common component). Reference: emitted at app load.
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:59 uses pointerEvents="box-none" as a prop.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Default dashboard month to the latest month with data when current month is empty, so first-run users see seeded totals.
(Nice-to-have) Replace `pointerEvents="box-none"` prop with `style={{ pointerEvents: 'box-none' }}` in app/(tabs)/index.tsx line 59 to silence RN deprecation warning.
(Nice-to-have) Audit library/custom styles using shadowOffset/shadowRadius/etc. and migrate to boxShadow where used only on web.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_masters/categories query uses {"deleted_at": None} which only matches documents where the field is explicitly null. Insert path sets deleted_at=None so this works, but any future doc inserted without the field will leak. Prefer {"$or": [{"deleted_at": None}, {"deleted_at": {"$exists": false}}]}.

PUT /api/expenses/{id} accepts ExpenseCreate (all required/optional fields) and fully overwrites. If any optional field is omitted from the frontend body, it will be reset. Current frontend sends full body so OK, but documenting as PATCH or using Optional+exclude_unset is safer.
No input validation that main_category/sub_category/detailed_head belong to CATEGORY_HIERARCHY or custom_categories. Free-text accepted. Low risk but worth noting.

success_rate.backend: 93% (13/14 - the 1 failure is a parallel-worker race in the test itself, not a bug)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows (dashboard load, month selector, expenses list + filters + scope, manage vendors CRUD, expense form open/fill/save/navigate back)

seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up test vendors (TEST_Vendor_A/UI_Vendor/UITest Vendor) and test expenses (TEST_Vendor_Expense, TEST_V2, TEST_V3). All test data removed via DELETE after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_paavni_api.py uses pytest classes with session-scoped created_ids dict. If running with xdist (-n auto), the TestDashboard.test_dashboard_month assertion `d[count] >= 2` may race against TestExpenses on another worker; run with -p no:xdist OR with --dist=loadfile for reliable results. All business logic (derive month/outstanding/payment_status, record_payment accumulation, soft-delete 404) is covered and verified passing.
rca_of_issue: No functional bugs found. The one failed test is a parallel execution artifact: pytest-xdist LoadScopeScheduling split TestDashboard and TestExpenses onto different workers, so test_dashboard_month ran before TestExpenses::test_create_* had inserted the 2026-01 rows. Confirmed by re-reading - business behavior is correct; only the test's ordering assumption is wrong under xdist.
